items.question: What share of Gen Z bought smartphones in the last 12 months?
items.answer:
**Smartphones: 42%** — share of Gen Z respondents who bought in the category in the last 12 months [D1].

### What the research says
- Among smartphones buyers, the most common product type is Refurbished smartphone (36% of buyers). Refurbished smartphone over-indexes with 16-19 year-olds (28% of its buyers), while Flagship smartphone skews older (41% aged 25-29). [S3]
- Purchase is balanced by gender (women 41%, men 43%). It is an older-Gen Z category: penetration rises from 39% among 16-19 year-olds to 45% among 25-29 year-olds. [S5]

### So what for marketers
Promote certified refurbished and trade-in as part of the main range, not an outlet; camera and battery are the decisive specs. [S6]
